- nda-3 (verbally conveyed info): Segment [7] says "provided verbally or in any other way not reduced in writing" — Confidential Information includes verbal disclosures. Entailment, evidence [7].
- nda-4 (Limited use): Segment [5] defines Purpose (supply, installation, testing, commissioning of CCTV). Segment [10] says "not to use the Confidential Information in any way" — actually it says no use at all except sharing. Hmm, the no-use clause combined with purpose suggests limited use. Entailment with [5], [10].
- nda-1 (Explicit identification): Segment [7] says "Confidential Information as identified and reduced in writing or provided verbally or in any other way not reduced in writing" — this suggests CI need NOT be expressly identified (can be verbal/not reduced in writing). - nda-2 (only technical info): Segment [3] lists security info, designs, software, customers etc. "customers" is non-technical, so CI includes non-technical info → Contradiction with [3].
- nda-7 (sharing with third parties): Segment [10] prohibits sharing with any Third Party → Contradiction with [10]. But maybe [44] amalgamation/merger exception allows assignment, not sharing. I'd say Contradiction [10].
- nda-8 (notice on compelled disclosure): Segment [11] says even if authorized under law, need express permission of Discloser — that's not exactly "notify". It requires permission, not notice. Hmm. This could be Entailment-ish but "notify" vs "express permission" differ. Many NDA datasets label this as Entailment if there's a clause about legally required disclosure with notice. Here [11] requires express permission before disclosure even if legally directed. That's stronger than notice. I'd lean NotMentioned or Entailment. Let me verify.
- nda-5 (sharing with employees): Not mentioned — no clause about employees. NotMentioned.
- nda-17 (permissible copy): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-12, nda-13 (independent development/acquirement): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-18 (no solicitation): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-19 (survival): Term clause [29] says continues until terminated; no survival clause. NotMentioned.
- nda-20 (retain after return): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-10 (confidentiality of agreement fact): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-11 (no reverse engineering): Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-15 (no licensing): Segment [7] grants access but no rights/license. Typically labeled Entailment with [7] in these datasets? Actually "No licensing" hypothesis: "Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information." There's no explicit statement. Often NotMentioned. Agent 0 is verifying [7].

Let me verify nda-16 with empty evidence to check NotMentioned, or verify nda-4 with [5],[10]. I'll start with nda-4.
